Overview

Bochum is a city in North Rhine-Westphalia with a population of 365,000. A university city in the Ruhr with a lively student scene, the German Mining Museum, and a thriving cultural and music heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
